Review Sketch?

Reviewers still see Sketch as a clean, intuitive, fast UI design tool with strong Mac performance and an interface many find easier to use than rivals. Users like it for everyday wireframing, prototyping, and, more recently, real-time collaboration. But the tone is also nostalgic: several say Sketch has lost ground to Figma, with a weaker plugin ecosystem, fewer features, Mac-only editing, and pricing that pushes some to stay on old versions or consider switching. Overall, it remains well-liked, but increasingly seen as behind the market.
